paragraphs: We are a diversified international transportation services company and one of the world's premier automotive and commercial truck retailers. We operate dealerships in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Italy, Japan, and Australia, and we are one of the largest retailers of commercial trucks in North America for Freightliner. We also distribute and retail commercial vehicles, diesel and gas engines, power systems, and related parts and services principally in Australia and New Zealand. We employ over 27,700 people worldwide. Additionally, we own 28.9% of Penske Transportation Solutions, a business that employs over 42,000 people worldwide, manages one of the largest, most comprehensive and modern trucking fleets in North America with over 396,600 trucks, tractors, and trailers under lease, rental, and/or maintenance contracts, and provides innovative transportation, supply chain, and technology solutions to its customers.

In 2025, our business generated $31.8 billion in total revenue, which is comprised of approximately $27.5 billion from retail automotive dealerships, $3.4 billion from retail commercial truck dealerships, and $922.6 million from commercial vehicle distribution and other operations. We generated $5.2 billion in gross profit, which is comprised of $4.5 billion from retail automotive dealerships, $542.3 million from retail commercial truck dealerships, and $192.3 million from commercial vehicle distribution and other operations.

Retail Automotive. We are one of the largest global automotive retailers as measured by the $27.5 billion in total retail automotive dealership revenue we generated in 2025. We are diversified geographically with 61% of our total retail automotive dealership revenues in 2025 generated in the U.S. and Puerto Rico and 39% generated outside of the U.S. We offer over 40 vehicle brands with 71% of our retail automotive franchised dealership revenue generated from premium brands, such as Audi, BMW, Land Rover, Lexus, Mercedes-Benz, and Porsche, and 23% of revenue generated from volume non-U.S. brands such as Toyota and Honda in 2025. As of December 31, 2025, we operated 365 retail automotive franchised dealerships, of which 148 are located in the U.S. and 217 are located outside of the U.S., principally in the U.K. As of December 31, 2025, we also operated 15 used vehicle dealerships, with six dealerships in the U.S. operating under the brand name CarShop, eight dealerships in the U.K. operating under the brand name Sytner Select, and one dealership in Australia operating under the brand name Penske Select. We retailed and wholesaled, including agency units, more than 583,000 vehicles in 2025.

In addition to selling new and used vehicles, we generate higher-margin revenue at each of our dealerships through maintenance and repair services, the sale and placement of third-party finance and insurance products, third-party extended service and maintenance contracts, replacement and aftermarket automotive products, and at certain of our locations, collision repair services. We operate our franchised dealerships under franchise agreements with a number of automotive manufacturers and distributors that are subject to certain rights and restrictions typical of the industry. Some of our dealerships in the U.K. and Europe operate under an agency model where we receive a fee for facilitating the sale by the manufacturer of a new vehicle but do not hold the vehicle in inventory. Vehicles sold under this agency model are counted as new agency units sold instead of new retail units sold by us, and only the fee we receive from the manufacturer, not the price of the vehicle, is reported as new revenue with no corresponding cost of sale.

During 2025, in the U.S. we sold four retail automotive franchises, closed one retail automotive franchise, and opened one retail automotive franchise. In addition, on November 19, 2025, we acquired Penske Motor Group, LLC ("PMG"), representing two Lexus brand locations and one Toyota brand location in California and one Toyota brand location in Texas, including Longo Toyota, the largest Toyota brand dealership in the U.S. This acquisition was accounted for as a transaction between entities under common control. Please refer to Part II, Item 8, Note 1 and Note 12 for further details. In the U.K., we sold one used vehicle dealership and opened eight retail automotive franchises at existing Sytner Select locations, representing the Geely and Chery brands, and opened two Skoda points at existing VW brand dealerships. We also acquired a Ferrari brand dealership in Modena, Italy, and opened a BYD franchise in Germany. During 2025, in aggregate, we acquired or opened dealerships representing approximately $1.6 billion in expected annualized revenue, of which $1.5 billion is related to our acquisition of PMG, and disposed of dealerships representing approximately $408.5 million of expected annualized revenue. In February 2026, we acquired Lexus of Orlando and Lexus of Winter Park, both located in the Orlando metropolitan area of Central Florida.

We believe our diversified retail automotive income streams help to mitigate the historical cyclicality found in some elements of the automotive sector. Revenues from higher margin service and parts sales include warranty work, customer-

paid work, rapid repair, collision repair services, and wholesale parts sales. Service and parts sales are typically less cyclical than retail vehicle sales and generate the largest part of our retail automotive gross profit.

Retail Commercial Truck Dealership. We operate Premier Truck Group ("PTG"), a heavy- and medium-duty retail truck dealership group offering primarily Freightliner and Western Star trucks (both Daimler brands), with locations across 10 U.S. states and the Canadian provinces of Ontario and Manitoba. As of December 31, 2025, PTG operated 45 locations selling new and/or used trucks, performing service and parts operations, or offering collision repair services. We retailed and wholesaled 19,239 new and used trucks in 2025.

While our retail commercial truck business benefits from diversified income streams similar to those of the retail automotive sector, there are several key differences. As exhibited in the following charts, a greater part of our gross profit is derived from the sale of service and parts in the retail truck business given the large volume of parts business, in many cases, to fleet customers. In addition, the commercial truck business has a historically lower selling, general, and administrative expense as a percentage of gross profit as compared to retail automotive as approximately 68% of PTG's gross profit is attributable to higher margin service and parts compared to retail automotive which is approximately 44%. Penske Australia. Penske Australia is the exclusive importer and distributor of Western Star heavy-duty trucks (a Daimler brand), MAN heavy- and medium-duty trucks and buses (a VW Group brand), and Dennis Eagle refuse collection vehicles, together with associated parts, across Australia, New Zealand, and portions of the Pacific. In most of these same markets, we are also a leading distributor of diesel and gas engines and power systems, principally representing MTU (a Rolls-Royce solution), Detroit Diesel, Allison Transmission, and Bergen Engines. Penske Australia offers products across the on- and off-highway markets, including in the trucking, mining, power generation, energy solutions, defense, marine, rail, and construction sectors and supports full parts and aftersales service through a network of branches, field service locations, and dealers across the region. We also own and operate three Porsche dealerships in Melbourne, Australia which results are included within our retail automotive segment described above.

Penske Transportation Solutions. We hold a 28.9% ownership interest in Penske Truck Leasing Co., L.P. ("PTL"). PTL is owned 41.1% by Penske Corporation, 28.9% by us, and 30.0% by Mitsui & Co., Ltd. ("Mitsui"). We account for our investment in PTL under the equity method, and we therefore record our share of PTL's earnings on our statements of income under the caption "Equity in earnings of affiliates," which also includes the results of our other equity method investments. Penske Transportation Solutions ("PTS") is the universal brand name for PTL's various businesses, which articulates the breadth of their services. PTS is capable of meeting customers' needs across the supply chain with a broad product offering that includes full-service truck leasing, truck rental, and contract maintenance along with logistics services, such as dedicated contract carriage, distribution center management, supply chain management, and dry van truckload carrier services.

Tariffs. During 2025, the U.S. enacted various tariffs on automobiles, automobile parts, medium- and heavy-duty trucks and truck parts which impacted each of our automotive and commercial vehicle suppliers, as well as our and PTS' operations. In February 2026, the Supreme Court ruled recent tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were unconstitutional though the Trump Administration has noted its intention to pursue further tariffs under a different authority. The policies and announcements regarding tariffs remain fluid, and we continue to monitor the impact of tariffs on our business and results of operations. For an additional discussion of certain risks associated tariffs, see Item 1A. Risk Factors, "Tariffs and Trade Risk" below.

Electric Vehicle ("EV") and Emissions Regulation. Federal and state governments and regulators in our markets have placed various restrictions on new retail automotive and commercial vehicles, in many cases requiring vehicle manufacturers to achieve progressively higher penetration of EVs or lower emissions of new internal combustion engine vehicle sales. The U.K. government requires in 2026 that 33% of new cars sold shall be electric vehicles (with limited allowances) and that manufacturers pay significant penalties if such amount is not achieved and also continues to propose a ban on the sale of internal combustion engines in new cars and new vans beginning in 2030, while allowing hybrid vehicles to be sold until 2035 and limited exceptions to the mandate for certain lower volume manufacturers. These U.K. regulations increase now through 2035 and continue to affect the profitability and mix of vehicles sold by our U.K. dealerships. For an additional discussion of certain risks associated with our business related to the EV and emissions, see Item 1A. Risk Factors, "Vehicle Emissions and Other Environmental Regulations" below.

paragraphs: Our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, prospects, and the prevailing market price and performance of our common stock may be affected by a number of factors, including the matters discussed below. Certain statements and information set forth herein as well as other written or oral statements made from time to time by us or by our authorized officers on our behalf, constitute "forward-looking statements" within the meaning of the Federal Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Words such as "anticipate," "believe," "estimate," "expect," "intend," "may," "goal," "plan," "seek," "project," "continue," "will," "would," and variations of such words and similar expressions are intended to identify such forward-looking statements. We intend for our forward-looking statements to be covered by the safe harbor provisions for forward-looking statements contained in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, and we set forth this statement in order to comply with such safe harbor provisions. You should note that our forward-looking statements speak only as of the date of this Annual Report on Form 10-K or when made, and we undertake no duty or obligation to update or revise our forward-looking statements, whether as a result of new information, future events, or otherwise.

Although we believe that the expectations, plans, intentions, and projections reflected in our forward-looking statements are reasonable, such statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors that may cause our actual results, performance, or achievements to be materially different from any future results, performance, or achievements expressed or implied by the forward-looking statements. The material risks, uncertainties, and other factors that our stockholders and prospective investors should consider include the following:

Macro-economic and geo-political conditions. Our performance is impacted by geo-political conditions and by general economic conditions overall and in particular by economic conditions in the markets in which we operate. These economic conditions include levels of new and used vehicle sales, availability of consumer credit, changes in consumer demand, consumer confidence levels, fuel prices, demand for trucks to move freight with respect to PTS and PTG, the rate of inflation, personal discretionary spending levels, interest rates, and unemployment rates. When the worldwide economy faltered early in 2020, we were adversely affected, and we expect a similar relationship between general economic and industry conditions and our performance in the future. PTG and PTS are currently experiencing weak market conditions in light of the continued recessionary freight environment, with PTG experiencing lower vehicle sales and PTS experiencing weak market conditions for used vehicle sales and commercial rental demand. While the diversification of our businesses have helped mitigate the impact of these conditions, a further prolonged freight market downturn will continue to impact our and PTS operating results.

Any geo-political developments that adversely affect the economies of our markets will also likely affect us. Moreover, geo-political conditions, including international conflict, can affect the vehicle supply chain as has happened with the war in Ukraine. Certain vehicle manufacturers and suppliers have experienced, and may continue to experience, difficulty sourcing certain parts which is further exacerbating the supply chain difficulties resulting from the demand for labor and the shortage of microchips and other components.

Many of our market countries have recently experienced a high rate of inflation. Inflation affects the price of vehicles, the price of parts, the rate of pay of our employees, the cost and availability of consumer credit, consumer demand, and our borrowing expenses. High rates of inflation may adversely affect consumer demand and increase our costs, which may materially and adversely affect us. Similarly, periods of rapid deflation in vehicle prices may materially and adversely affect our ability to profitably sell the affected vehicles.

Adverse conditions affecting one or more significant automotive manufacturers or suppliers will affect us. Our success depends on the overall success of the automotive and commercial vehicle industries generally and in particular, on the success of the brands of vehicles that each of our dealerships sell. In 2025, revenue generated at our BMW/MINI, Audi/Volkswagen/Porsche/Bentley, Toyota/Lexus, and Mercedes-Benz/Sprinter/smart dealerships represented 25%, 22%, 18%, and 8%, respectively, or 73% in aggregate, of our total automotive dealership revenues. In addition, our retail commercial truck operations rely principally on Freightliner and Western Star trucks (both Daimler brands). These manufacturers operate independently of us and we have no control over their operational decisions and future plans. We are subject to a concentration of risk in the event of adverse events or financial distress, including bankruptcy, impacting one or more of these manufacturers.

Automotive and commercial truck dealerships represent 97.1% of our revenue and 80.9% of our earnings before taxes during 2025. Income from our PTS investment represents 15.3% of our earnings before taxes during 2025. New and used vehicle revenues typically include sales to retail customers, agency customers, fleet customers, and leasing companies providing consumer leasing. We generate finance and insurance revenues from sales of third-party extended service contracts, sales of third-party insurance policies, commissions relating to the sale of finance and lease contracts to third parties, and the sales of certain other products. Service and parts revenues include fees paid by customers for repair, maintenance and collision services, and the sale of replacement parts and other aftermarket accessories as well as warranty repairs that are reimbursed directly by vehicle manufacturers.

Our gross profit tends to vary with the mix of revenues we derive from the sale of new vehicles, used vehicles, finance and insurance products, and service and parts transactions. Our gross profit varies across product lines with vehicle sales usually resulting in lower gross profit margins and our other revenues resulting in higher gross profit margins. Factors such as inventory and vehicle availability, customer demand, consumer confidence, unemployment, general economic conditions, seasonality, weather, credit availability, the impact of tariffs and non-tariff trade barriers, fuel prices, and manufacturers' advertising and incentives also impact the mix of our revenues and therefore, influence our gross profit margin. The results of our commercial vehicle distribution and other business in Australia and New Zealand are principally driven by the number and types of products and vehicles ordered by our customers.

As exchange rates fluctuate, our revenue and results of operations as reported in U.S. Dollars fluctuate. For example, if the British Pound were to weaken against the U.S. Dollar, our U.K. results of operations would translate into less U.S. Dollar reported results. Foreign currency average rate fluctuations increased revenue and gross profit by $302.3 million and $43.1 million, respectively, in 2025. Foreign currency average rate fluctuations increased earnings per share by approximately $0.04 per share in 2025. Excluding the impact of foreign currency average rate fluctuations, aggregate revenue and gross profit decreased 1.1% and 0.8%, respectively, in 2025.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家多元化國際運輸服務公司，並為全球首屈一指的汽車及商用貨車零售商之一。本公司於美國、英國、加拿大、德國、義大利、日本及澳洲經營經銷據點，並為北美 Freightliner 商用貨車零售業者中規模最大的零售商之一。本公司亦於澳洲及紐西蘭等地分銷及零售商用車輛、柴油及汽油引擎、動力系統及相關零組件與服務。本公司全球僱用逾 27,700 名員工。此外，本公司持有 Penske Transportation Solutions 28.9% 的股權，該企業全球僱用逾 42,000 名員工，管理著北美規模最大、最完整且現代化的貨車運輸隊伍，擁有逾 396,600 輛貨車、牽引車及拖車，並透過租賃、租借及/或維護合約進行管理，同時為客戶提供創新運輸、供應鏈及科技解決方案。
2025 年，本公司營業收入為 31.8 十億美元，其中約 27.5 十億美元來自零售汽車經銷業務，3.4 十億美元來自零售商用貨車經銷業務，以及 922.6 百萬美元來自商用車輛分銷及其他業務。本公司產生 5.2 十億美元的毛利率，其中 4.5 十億美元來自零售汽車經銷業務，542.3 百萬美元來自零售商用貨車經銷業務，以及 192.3 百萬美元來自商用車輛分銷及其他業務。

零售汽車業務。本公司為全球規模最大的汽車零售商之一，以 2025 年產生 27.5 十億美元的零售汽車經銷業務營業收入為衡量標準。本公司在地理分佈上多元化，2025 年總零售汽車經銷業務營收中，61% 來自美國及波多黎各，39% 來自美國以外地區。本公司提供超過 40 種車輛品牌，其中 71% 的零售汽車特許經銷業務營收來自高階品牌，如 Audi、BMW、Land Rover、Lexus、Mercedes-Benz 及 Porsche，以及 23% 的營收來自於非美國大眾品牌，如 Toyota 及 Honda。2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司經營 365 家零售汽車特許經銷據點，其中 148 家位於美國，217 家位於美國以外地區，主要為英國。2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司亦經營 15 家二手車經銷據點，其中 6 家位於美國，以 CarShop 品牌營運，8 家位於英國，以 Sytner Select 品牌營運，1 家位於澳洲，以 Penske Select 品牌營運。2025 年，本公司零售及批發（含代理單位）逾 583,000 輛車輛。

除了銷售新車與二手車外，本公司於各經銷據點透過維修與保養服務、銷售及安排第三方財務與保險產品、第三方延長保養與維修合約、更換及後市場汽車產品，以及部分據點的碰撞修復服務，產生更高毛利率的收入。本公司透過與多家汽車製造商及經銷商簽訂特許經銷合約經營特許經銷據點，這些合約通常包含某些權利與限制。本公司部分位於英國及歐洲的經銷據點採用代理模式，本公司透過協助製造商銷售新車收取費用，但不持有車輛存貨。透過此代理模式銷售的車輛計為新代理單位銷售，而非本公司銷售的新零售單位，且僅本公司從製造商收取的費用，而非車輛價格，被計為新收入，且無對應的銷售成本。

2025 年，於美國，我們出售了四家零售汽車經銷商，關閉了一家零售汽車經銷商，並開設了一家零售汽車經銷商。此外，於 2025 年 11 月 19 日，我們取得 Penske Motor Group, LLC（"PMG"），代表兩家 Lexus 品牌經銷商與一家 Toyota 品牌經銷商位於加州，以及一家 Toyota 品牌經銷商位於德州，包括 Longo Toyota，為美國最大的 Toyota 品牌經銷商。此取得行為被視為為共同控制實體間之交易。請參閱第二部分，第 8 項，附註 1 與附註 12 以取得更多細節。於英國，我們出售了一家二手車經銷商，並在現有 Sytner Select 經銷商場地開設了八家零售汽車經銷商，代表 Geely 與 Chery 品牌，並在現有 VW 品牌經銷商場地開設了兩家 Skoda 經銷點。我們也取得了一家 Ferrari 品牌經銷商位於意大利摩德納，並在德國開設了一家 BYD 經銷商。2025 年，總計我們取得或開設經銷商，預期年營收約為 1.6 十億美元，其中 1.5 十億美元與我們取得 PMG 有關，並處置經銷商，預期年營收約為 408.5 百萬美元。2026 年 2 月，我們取得 Orlando 與 Winter Park 的 Lexus 經銷商，兩家均位於美國佛羅裏達州中部 Orlando 都市區。
我們認為我們多元化的零售汽車收入來源有助於緩解汽車產業某些部分歷史上的週期性。來自較高毛利率服務與零組件銷售的收入包括保養工作、客戶
已付款工作、快速修復、碰撞修復服務以及整售零組件銷售。服務與零組件銷售通常較零售車輛銷售較不具週期性，並產生我們零售汽車業務毛利率的最大部分。
以下圖表顯示我們零售汽車經銷商收入中，各產品類型所佔的百分比及其對我們零售汽車業務毛利率的貢獻：

零售商用貨車經銷商。我們經營Premier Truck Group ("PTG")，為一間主要銷售Freightliner及Western Star貨車（皆為Daimler品牌）的重機與中型貨車零售經銷集團，營業據點遍及美國10個州及加拿大安大略省與曼尼托巴省。截至2025年12月31日，PTG經營45個據點，銷售新舊貨車、進行服務與零件業務，或提供碰撞修復服務。我們在2025年零售與批發了19,239輛新舊貨車。

雖然我們的零售商用貨車業務與零售汽車產業一樣擁有多元化的收入來源，但仍有幾個關鍵差異。如後述圖表所示，我們的毛利率較多來自零售貨車業務中服務與零件的銷售，這是因為零件業務的交易量非常大，許多情況下是針對車隊客戶。此外，商用貨車業務歷來在毛利率中，銷售、一般及行政費用所佔比例較零售汽車產業為低，約為PTG毛利率的68%來自較高毛利的服務與零件，而零售汽車產業則約為44%。後述圖表顯示我們零售商用貨車經銷商收入中，各產品類型所佔的百分比及其對零售商用貨車毛利率的貢獻：

Penske Australia。Penske Australia為Western Star重機貨車（Daimler品牌）、MAN重機與中型貨車及巴士（VW Group品牌）以及Dennis Eagle垃圾收集車輛的獨家進口與經銷商，同時也經銷相關零件，遍及澳洲、紐西蘭及太平洋部分地區。在這些相同市場中，我們也是柴油與汽油引擎及發電系統的主要經銷商，主要代表MTU（Rolls-Royce解決方案）、Detroit Diesel、Allison Transmission及Bergen Engines。Penske Australia提供產品於道路與非道路市場，包括貨車、採礦、發電、能源解決方案、防禦、船運、鐵路及建設等產業，並透過遍佈地區的據點、現場服務中心及經銷商網路提供完整的零件與後市場服務。我們也擁有並營運三間位於澳洲墨爾本的Porsche經銷商，其結果包含於上述零售汽車產業段落中所描述的零售汽車產業段落。

Penske Transportation Solutions。我們持有Penske Truck Leasing Co., L.P. ("PTL") 28.9%的股權。PTL由Penske Corporation持有41.1%、我們持有28.9%、Mitsui & Co., Ltd. ("Mitsui")持有30.0%。我們以權益法計入對PTL的投資，因此我們在財務報表中以"權益法投資的收益"名稱記錄我們的收益，也包含我們其他權益法投資的結果。Penske Transportation Solutions ("PTS")為PTL各項業務的通用品牌名稱，說明其服務範疇的廣度。PTS有能力透過廣泛的產品組合，滿足客戶在供應鏈中的需求，包括全服務貨車租賃、貨車租賃及合約維護，以及物流服務，如專屬合約運輸、倉儲中心管理、供應鏈管理及乾貨貨車整車運輸服務。

關稅。2025年，美國對汽車、汽車零件、中型及重型貨車及貨車零件課徵多項關稅，影響我們的汽車及商用車供應商，以及我們與PTS的營運。2026年2月，美國最高法院裁定根據國際緊急經濟權力法案（IEEPA）所課的近期關稅違憲，不過特朗普政府表示有意在不同權限下繼續推行關稅。有關關稅的政策與公告仍處於流動狀態，我們持續監測關稅對我們業務與營運結果的影響。有關關稅相關風險的進一步討論，請參見第1A項「風險因素」中「關稅與貿易風險」部分。

電動車（"EV"）與排放規範。我們市場中的聯邦與州政府及監管機構對新零售汽車與商用車設有各種限制，許多情況下要求車輛製造商逐步提高電動車的市場佔有率或降低新內燃機車輛銷售的排放。英國政府要求2026年起，銷售的新車中33%必須為電動車（有限制例外），若未達成則製造商需支付重大罰款，同時持續提出2030年起禁止銷售新車與新貨車內燃機，允許混合動力車輛銷售至2035年，並對部分低產量製造商有有限例外。這些英國規範自2025年起生效，並持續影響我們英國經銷商的獲利能力與銷售車型組合。有關電動車與排放相關風險的進一步討論，請參見第1A項「風險因素」中「車輛排放及其他環境規範」部分。

paragraphs: 本項管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運成果包含前瞻性聲明，涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與前瞻性聲明中所討論的結果有重大差異，原因包括各種因素，包括在「第 1A 項 風險因素」及「前瞻性聲明」中所討論的內容。我們在本項管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運成果所涵蓋的期間內，已取得、處置及啟動了許多業務。我們的財務報表包含這些業務自取得日期或開始營運日期起的營運結果。我們的營運結果可能因取得或處置日期的不同而有所變動。

我們是一家多元化國際運輸服務公司，也是全球首屈一指的汽車及商用貨車零售商之一。我們在美國、英國、加拿大、德國、義大利、日本及澳洲經營經銷據點，並為 Freightliner 在北美地區最大的商用貨車零售商。我們也於澳洲及紐西蘭分銷及零售商用車輛、柴油及汽油引擎、動力系統及相關零件與服務。我們在全球僱用超過 27,700 名員工。此外，我們持有 Penske Transportation Solutions 28.9% 的股份，這是一家僱用超過 42,000 名員工的公司，管理著北美地區規模最大、最全面且現代化的貨車運輸隊伍，擁有超過 396,600 輛貨車、牽引車及拖車，並透過租賃、租借及/或維護合約進行管理，同時為客戶提供創新運輸、供應鏈及科技解決方案。
2025 年，我們的業務產生總營業收入 31.8 十億美元，其中約 27.5 十億美元來自零售汽車經銷據點，3.4 十億美元來自零售商用貨車經銷據點，以及 922.6 百萬美元來自商用車輛分銷及其他業務。我們產生 5.2 十億美元的毛利，其中 4.5 十億美元來自零售汽車經銷據點，542.3 百萬美元來自零售商用貨車經銷據點，以及 192.3 百萬美元來自商用車輛分銷及其他業務。

零售汽車業務。我們是全球最大的汽車零售商之一，以 2025 年產生 27.5 十億美元總零售汽車經銷據點營收為衡量標準。我們在地理上多元化，2025 年總零售汽車經銷據點營收的 61% 來自美國及波多黎各，39% 來自美國以外地區。我們提供超過 40 個車輛品牌，其中 71% 的零售汽車特許經銷據點營收來自 premium 品牌，如 Audi、BMW、Land Rover、Lexus、Mercedes-Benz 及 Porsche，以及 23% 的營收來自 volume 非美國品牌，如 Toyota 及 Honda。2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們經營 365 家零售汽車特許經銷據點，其中 148 家位於美國，217 家位於美國以外地區，主要在英國。2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們也經營 15 家二手車經銷據點，其中美國有 6 家經銷據點以 CarShop 品牌營運，英國有 8 家經銷據點以 Sytner Select 品牌營運，澳洲有 1 家經銷據點以 Penske Select 品牌營運。我們在 2025 年零售及批發（包括代理單位）超過 583,000 輛車輛。

除了銷售新車及二手車外，我們在各經銷據點透過維修與保養服務、銷售及安排第三方財務與保險產品、第三方延長保養與維修合約、替換及後市場汽車產品，以及在部分據點提供碰撞修復服務，產生更高毛利的收入。我們在特許經銷據點營運模式下，與多家汽車製造商及經銷商簽訂特許經銷協議，這些協議通常會有特定的權利與限制。我們在英國及歐洲的一些經銷據點採用代理模式，我們會收取協助製造商銷售新車的費用，但不持有車輛存貨。透過此代理模式銷售的車輛會計入新代理單位銷售，而非我們的新零售單位銷售，且僅會將我們從製造商收取的費用，而非車輛價格，計入新收入，且無對應的銷售成本。

2025 年，在美國，我們出售了四家零售汽車特許經銷據點，關閉了一家零售汽車特許經銷據點，並開設了一家零售汽車特許經銷據點。此外，2025 年 11 月 19 日，我們取得了 Penske Motor Group, LLC（"PMG"）的所有會員權益，代表在加州的兩家 Lexus 品牌據點及一家 Toyota 品牌據點，以及在德州的一家 Toyota 品牌據點，包括 Longo Toyota，這是美國最大的 Toyota 品牌經銷據點。此筆取得被視為在共同控制實體之間的交易。請參閱第二部分，第 8 項，附註 1 及附註 12 以取得更多細節。在英國，我們出售了一家二手車經銷據點，並在現有 Sytner Select 擁有據點開設了八家零售汽車特許經銷據點，代表 Geely 及 Chery 品牌，並在現有 VW 品牌經銷據點開設了兩家 Skoda 擁有據點。我們也取得了一家 Ferrari 品牌經銷據點，位於義大利摩德納，並在德國開設了一家 BYD 特許經銷據點。2025 年，我們總計取得或開設經銷據點，預期年營收約為 1.6 十億美元，其中 1.5 十億美元與取得 PMG 有關，並處置了經銷據點，預期年營收約為 408.5 百萬美元。2026 年 2 月，我們取得了位於美國佛羅裏達州奧蘭多都會區的 Lexus of Orlando 及 Lexus of Winter Park。
零售商用貨車經銷據點。我們經營 Premier Truck Group（"PTG"），這是一家主要銷售 Freightliner 及 Western Star 貨車（皆為 Daimler 品牌）的重型及中型商用貨車零售經銷據點羣，分佈於美國 10 個州及加拿大安大略省與馬尼託巴省。2025 年 12 月 31 日，PTG 營運 45 個據點，
銷售新車及/或二手車、進行維修與零件業務，或提供碰撞修復服務。我們在 2025 年零售及批發 19,239 輛新車及二手車。

Penske Australia. Penske Australia 是西方星重型貨車（一 Daimler 品牌）, MAN 重型及中型貨車與巴士（一 VW Group 品牌）以及 Dennis Eagle 垃圾收集車輛，與相關零組件，在澳洲、紐西蘭及太平洋部分地區的獨家進口與經銷商。在這些相同市場中，我們也是柴油與氣體引擎與動力系統的主要經銷商，主要代表 MTU（一 Rolls-Royce 解決方案）、Detroit Diesel、Allison Transmission 與 Bergen Engines。Penske Australia 提供產品於道路與非道路市場，包括貨車、礦業、發電、能源解決方案、防禦、海運、鐵路與建設產業，並透過地區內的分支機構、現場服務據點與經銷商網路提供完整的零組件與後市場服務。我們也擁有並營運三間位於澳洲墨爾本的 Porsche 經銷商，其結果包含於上述的零售汽車分部中。

Penske Transportation Solutions. 我們持有 Penske Truck Leasing Co., L.P. ("PTL") 28.9% 的股權。PTL 由 Penske Corporation 持有 41.1%，我們持有 28.9%，以及 Mitsui & Co., Ltd. ("Mitsui") 持有 30.0%。我們以權益法計提對 PTL 的投資，因此我們在財務報表的營業收入中，將我們的權益收益列為 "權益收益來自合資公司"，也包含我們其他權益法投資的結果。Penske Transportation Solutions ("PTS") 是 PTL 各種業務的通用品牌名稱，說明其服務範疇的廣度。PTS 可以根據供應鏈的需要，提供廣泛的產品組合，包括全服務貨車租賃、貨車租賃與合約維護，以及物流服務，如專屬合約運輸、配送中心管理、供應鏈管理與乾貨貨車整車運輸服務。我們在 2025 年與 2024 年分別記錄了 192.8 百萬美元與 198.0 百萬美元的權益收益來自此投資。
請參閱第一部分，第 1 項的 "展望"，以瞭解我們在市場的展望討論。

汽車與商用貨車經銷商代表我們 2025 年營業收入的 97.1%，以及稅前獲利的 80.9%。來自 PTS 投資的獲利代表我們 2025 年稅前獲利的 15.3%。新與二手車銷售收入通常包括銷售給零售客戶、代理商客戶、車隊客戶與提供消費者租賃的租賃公司。我們從銷售第三方延長服務合約、銷售第三方保險政策、與第三方銷售財務與租賃合約相關的佣金，以及銷售某些其他產品中產生財務與保險收入。服務與零組件收入包括客戶為修理、維護與碰撞服務支付的費用，以及銷售替換零組件與其他後市場配件，以及由車輛製造商直接補償的保修修理。

我們的毛利通常會根據我們來自新車銷售、二手車銷售、財務與保險產品以及服務與零組件交易的收入組成而有所變動。我們的毛利會因產品線而異，車輛銷售通常會導致較低的毛利邊際，而我們的其他收入則會導致較高的毛利邊際。因素如存貨與車輛可得性、客戶需求、消費者信心、失業率、總體經濟狀況、季節性、天氣、信貸可得性、關稅與非關稅貿易壁壘的影響、燃料價格，以及製造商的廣告與激勵措施，也會影響我們的收入組成，因此影響我們的毛利邊際。我們在澳洲與紐西蘭的商用車輛經銷與其他業務的結果，主要由我們客戶訂購的產品與車輛種類與數量所驅動。

由於匯率波動，我們以美元報告的收入與營運結果會有所變動。例如，如果英鎊對美元 depreciate，我們在英國的營運結果會轉換為較少的美元報告結果。2025 年，外幣平均匯率波動使收入與毛利分別增加了 302.3 百萬美元與 43.1 百萬美元。2025 年，外幣平均匯率波動使每股盈餘增加了約 0.04 美元。扣除外幣平均匯率波動的影響，2025 年總體收入與毛利分別下降了 1.1% 與 0.8%。

paragraphs: 本公司營運、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流量、前景及本公司普通股的市場價格與表現，可能受多項因素影響，包括下列所述事項。部分 herein 所述之陳述與資訊，以及我們或經授權代表本公司之高層所作之書面或口頭陳述，屬於 1995 年聯邦私人證券訴訟改革法案 所定義之「預測性陳述」。詞彙如「預期」、「相信」、「估計」、「期望」、「意圖」、「可能」、「目標」、「計畫」、「追求」、「預測」、「持續」、「將」、「會」等及其變體與相似表達方式，旨在識別此類預測性陳述。本公司意圖讓預測性陳述受 1995 年私人證券訴訟改革法案 所含之預測性陳述安全港條款保護，並作出此聲明以符合該安全港條款。您應注意，本公司預測性陳述僅為本 10-K 年度報告或作出時之陳述，本公司不負有更新或修正預測性陳述之義務，無論因新資訊、未來事件或其他原因。
雖然我們認為預測性陳述所反映之預期、計畫、意圖與預測為合理，但此類陳述受已知與未知風險、不確定性及其他因素影響，可能導致本公司實際結果、表現或成就與預測性陳述所表達或暗示之未來結果、表現或成就有重大差異。股東與潛在投資者應考慮之重大風險、不確定性及其他因素包括下列事項：

總體經濟與地緣政治條件。本公司表現受地緣政治條件與總體經濟條件影響，特別是我們營運市場之經濟條件。這些經濟條件包括新舊車輛銷售數量、消費者信貸可得性、消費者需求變化、消費者信心指數、燃料價格、PTS 與 PTG 對貨運用卡車之需求、通貨膨脹率、個人可支配支出水平、利率與失業率。當全球經濟在 2020 年初陷入衰退時，本公司受到負面影響，我們預期未來總體經濟與產業條件與本公司表現之間仍將有類似關係。目前 PTS 與 PTG 面臨弱勢市場條件，因持續的貨運市場衰退，PTG 面臨較低的車輛銷售，PTS 則面臨二手車銷售與商業租賃需求之弱勢市場條件。雖然本公司業務多元化有助於緩解這些條件的影響，但若貨運市場進一步衰退，將持續影響本公司與 PTS 之營運結果。
任何不利於我們市場經濟體之地緣政治發展，也將可能影響本公司。此外，地緣政治條件，包括國際衝突，可能影響車輛供應鏈，如烏克蘭戰爭所顯示。部分車輛製造商與供應商已遭遇，且可能繼續遭遇，某些零組件之供應困難，進一步惡化因勞動力需求與微晶片及其他零組件短缺所導致的供應鏈問題。
許多我們營運國家近期經歷高通貨膨脹率。通貨膨脹影響車輛價格、零組件價格、本公司員工薪資水平、消費者信貸成本與可得性、消費者需求以及本公司借款成本。高通貨膨脹率可能不利於消費者需求，並提高本公司成本，可能對本公司造成重大且不利的影響。同樣地，車輛價格快速下跌期間，可能對本公司以利潤方式銷售受影響車輛的能力造成重大且不利的影響。

影響一個或多個重要汽車製造商或供應商之不利條件，將影響本公司。本公司之成功取決於汽車與商用車產業整體之成功，特別是我們經銷商所銷售之車輛品牌之成功。2025 年，本公司 BMW/MINI、Audi/Volkswagen/Porsche/Bentley、Toyota/Lexus、以及 Mercedes-Benz/Sprinter/smart 經銷商所產生之收入分別佔本公司總汽車經銷商收入的 25%、22%、18%、8%，合計為 73%。此外，本公司零售商用卡車業務主要依賴 Freightliner 與 Western Star 卡車（皆為 Daimler 品牌）。這些製造商獨立於本公司運作，本公司對其運營決策與未來計畫毫無控制權。若這些製造商遭遇不利事件或財務困難，包括破產，本公司將面臨集中風險。
